general.notes: Title states 9.4dB power budget and 1270nm-1330nm (4ch). Power budget for 32G FC is 0 – 9.4dB. Dispersion penalty max 4.5dB stated without a paired penalized parameter and operating condition for penalty objects. Transmitter output power and receiver min input/overload are average power (footnote 1). Receiver minimum input power and overload for 32G FC are @ BER 1x10-6, PRBS 2^31-1, back-to-back (footnote 2). FEC required to be implemented by the host for 32G FC and 25G Ethernet. Operating temperature listed as -0°C to +70°C. Ordering code SO-SFP28-32GFC-LR10-C29 description prints 12790nm (likely typo for 1279nm); wavelength_center_nm uses only explicitly plausible nm values from ordering (1270, 1310, 1330). Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C is not normal operating range.
general.suggestions: Consider mapping power budget (dB) and dispersion penalty (dB) to dedicated schema fields. Clarify whether -0°C operating minimum should be recorded as 0°C.
